data.long_meaning: The meaning of Marmaduke is recorded in name-lists as “Mighty warrior”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Marmaduke expresses “Mighty warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marmaduke total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: מַרְמָדוּק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words 'mar' (bitter) and 'madad' (to work or labor).

in_greek.name: Μαρμάδοκος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words 'marmar' (mildly bitter) and 'dokos' (rule or leader).

in_latin.name: Marmaduke
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin words 'marmare' (to be bitter) and 'ducere' (to lead).
